craft_notes: Sthāyin: company — transgressive collective. Rows: members roll; oneness closes. Rejected: sanitizing — killed: members are the doctrine. Read aloud: gathering hush.

lines: Master, his line and sons, truth-knower, maid,
in the wheel, first-honored, all as one.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra guruḥ tadvargyaḥ sasaṃtānaḥ tattvavit kanyā antyā veśyā aruṇā tattvavedinī vā iti cakrayāge mukhyapūjyāḥ viśeṣāt sāmastyena
